_units: meters, seconds, m/s, m/s2, degrees per second. Phase 4 will scale these by player stats.
_speed_modes: walk (soft joystick, fixed speed), run (full joystick), sprint (SPRINT), knock-on (joystick pulled hard twice, with the ball: full sprint speed). Turning grip: how fast the direction can change, x1 at run speed, more when slow, less at full sprint.
_shot_on_target: Shots aim into the goal: a stick pointing at the goal keeps its aim (up to shot_assist_margin past a post), elsewhere it aims shot_post_inset inside the post on that side, no stick = the corner away from the keeper. Tight angle (goal seen under shot_tight_angle_degrees) and back to the goal add error. CLEAR = SHOOT in our own half (before clear_zone_frac of the court).
_keeper_hands: Keeper with the ball in his hands: held keeper_hands_height high, keeper_hands_forward in front, never closer than keeper_hands_line_margin to his goal line; thrown automatically after keeper_hands_seconds. Throw = pass speed with keeper_throw_lift, error x keeper_throw_error_mult. Long kick lands about keeper_long_kick_landing of the way to the teammate.
_kick_power: Power bar: SHOOT fills it from the press over shot_charge_time. PASS, THROUGH and CLEAR (and the keeper's throw and long kick) kick on release: a tap (under kick_tap_seconds) keeps the automatic power, a longer hold fills the bar over kick_charge_time and the bar sets the power: pass speed, through-pass lead in front of the runner, clearance speed and height, throw speed, long-kick landing distance. In the red end (kick_red_zone..1) passes and clearances get up to kick_red_error_mult aim error, and a shot rises up to shot_red_lift m/s more by chance, times the shooter's finishing error over shot_red_reference_degrees (clamped shot_red_scale_min..max): it can fly over the crossbar.
_lofted: Lofted pass / lofted through ball (PASS or THROUGH with the finger slid up): lands lofted_distance_min..max away by the power bar (filled from the press), rising to lofted_apex_base + lofted_apex_per_meter per meter (clamped lofted_apex_min..max). Air control: a ball coming down can be taken up to air_control_height (chest) with air_control_chance (ball control stat), minus air_control_speed_penalty per m/s above air_control_easy_speed (not below air_control_chance_min); missed, it bounces off (air_heavy_touch_*) and he cannot retake it for air_heavy_touch_block s.
_shot_types: Shot types by a slide on SHOOT (ShotTypes); the bar sets only the power. Low (down): on the ground, speed shot_low_speed_min..max. Chip (up): comes down shot_chip_distance_min..max away by the power, apex shot_chip_apex_base + per_meter (clamped min..max); its ideal power brings it through the goal line at shot_chip_cross_height. Curl (left or right): to shot_curl_post_inset inside the far post at shot_curl_height, spin shot_curl_spin, aimed (simulated) so the ideal power curls it in; ideal power shot_curl_ideal_base + per_meter (clamped); speed shot_curl_speed_min..max; lift changes shot_curl_lift_per_power per unit of power away from the ideal. A finisher's mistake is scaled by his finishing error over shot_red_reference_degrees, clamped shot_skill_damp_min..max.
